note: Screen S3 (output/research/screen7/s3_clv_model.json). At the Tuesday 14:10 UTC run, predict the Tuesday->close move of the consensus home spread from Tuesday-only information and bet the top decile in the direction of the predicted move at today's number. Walk-forward 2023-25 (hourly odds), games without a starting-QB change, model margin without injury-report inputs: 62 bets, CLV +0.62 pts per bet (p 0.0003; 57% moved our way, 23% against), ATS 58.1%, ROI +10.6% +- 12.0%, positive all 3 seasons. An earlier version that used final-report injuries and actual starters looked far better (+1.0 pt, 64%) because of look-ahead; that version is NOT this rule. Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.

qualify.skip_if: either team's expected starting QB differs from its previous starter (qb_change != 0) or a QB is on the injury report (play_prob < 1)

features.pt: Tuesday consensus home point = -(median home margin across sportsbooks, Pinnacle and exchanges excluded)
features.f_pin: Pinnacle home point - pt (0 if missing)

qualify.predicted_move: const + sum(coef*feature): + = home point will rise (market moves toward the away team) -> bet AWAY now; - -> bet HOME now
qualify.price: best price for that side among my_books.json allowed books at the most favorable point

grading.clv_points: our point vs the last pre-kickoff consensus point (our-side points gained)
grading.result: ATS at our point and price

validation.test: mean CLV points > 0 with one-sided p < 0.05 AND ROI >= 0
